name: codex-autoresearch
description: Codex plugin for bounded, measured benchmark and optimization loops.

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --node-plugin --promise-plugin --react-plugin --jsx-a11y-plugin --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern dashboard/src lib scripts tests vite.dashboard.config.ts tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.dashboard.json tsdown.config.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --write --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern dashboard/src lib scripts tests vite.dashboard.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.dashboard.json tsdown.config.ts package.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern dashboard/src lib scripts tests vite.dashboard.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.dashboard.json tsdown.config.ts package.json
scripts.test:compiled: run-s test:compiled:cli test:compiled:dashboard test:compiled:finalize test:compiled:process test:compiled:core
scripts.test:compiled:perf: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', '--test-timeout=120000', '--test-name-pattern', 'compact read commands stay within a warm local startup budget', 'dist/tests/cli/entrypoint-startup.test.mjs'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, CODEX_AUTORESEARCH_RUN_PERF_TESTS: '1' }, windowsHide: true }); if (result.error) throw result.error; process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.test:compiled:core: node --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-concurrency=8 dist/tests/bootstrap-runtime.test.mjs dist/tests/coherent-session-snapshot.test.mjs dist/tests/decision-compiler.test.mjs dist/tests/decision-projection.test.mjs dist/tests/evidence-core.test.mjs dist/tests/experiment-contract.test.mjs dist/tests/outcome-foundation.test.mjs dist/tests/result-semantics.test.mjs dist/tests/investigation-workflow.test.mjs dist/tests/tool-contracts-decision-protocol.test.mjs dist/tests/experiment-memory.test.mjs dist/tests/command-builders.test.mjs dist/tests/check-runner.test.mjs dist/tests/benchmark-constraints.test.mjs dist/tests/loop-governance.test.mjs dist/tests/session-control-plane.test.mjs dist/tests/packet-diagnostics.test.mjs dist/tests/state-finalization-readout.test.mjs dist/tests/source-hygiene.test.mjs dist/tests/hostile-workflow.test.mjs dist/tests/product-claim-coverage.test.mjs dist/tests/dashboard-server-registry.test.mjs dist/tests/decision-guidance-dashboard-health.test.mjs dist/tests/decision-guidance-gate-quality.test.mjs dist/tests/decision-guidance-lane-briefs.test.mjs dist/tests/decision-guidance-runtime-drift.test.mjs dist/tests/decision-guidance-task-artifacts.test.mjs dist/tests/decision-guidance-terminal-report.test.mjs
scripts.test:compiled:platform:git: node --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-name-pattern="^(scoped keep commits preserve unrelated staged files|discard reverts scoped experiment paths without deleting unrelated dirty work|keep logs report structured git index lock recovery|keep commit creation does not execute repository hooks)$" dist/tests/cli/git-transactions.test.mjs
scripts.check: run-p typecheck lint format:check && npm run check:product
